mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when this trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 0.5% coincident with a rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand but a nascent housing recovery, resulting in muted but positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as sector rotation occurs.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -0.5% AND HOUST > previous 3-month average
regime_hint: late-cycle demand softening with sector rotation
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of at least 0.4% for three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for 3 consecutive months by at least 0.4% each month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a fall in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) within the same month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and cost of capital, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate higher earnings.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises AND UNRATE falls in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) of more than 0.7% for four consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue for consumer-facing sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls for 4 consecutive months by > 0.7% each month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3% while the federal funds rate remains below 2% for three consecutive months, it signals a lagged monetary policy response to inflation, which increases uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3% AND FEDFUNDS < 2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: An above-trend increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month while GDP growth (GDPC1) is flat or negative signals a housing-led demand recovery, which boosts construction and materials sector stocks and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month +10% AND GDPC1 <= 0% QoQ annualized
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes.
